justification: Changes how the flood planning endpoint gets its database connection (pool + one retry) and drops a duplicate timeout statement. Answers are unchanged. Standard: live endpoint path.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Fails if a dropped pooled connection is not retried on a fresh one, if a good answer opens a second connection, or if the near-edge check sends its own timeout trip.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Real DB 2026-10-30 from this PC: six answers (Sydney, Ballina, Cessnock twice) on one reused connection, 0.06-0.52 s each, same values as before.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Live endpoint 2.4-3.8 s per answer with 0.05-0.4 s of DB work; every request opened a new connection.

pre_impl.existing_data: No table or stored data changes; only how connections are opened.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Endpoint assumed a new connection per request is cheap; it is several Sydney round trips.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: psycopg2 ThreadedConnectionPool, already installed; no new source.
pre_impl.external_source_error: A dead pooled connection gives 'could not be checked', then one retry on a fresh connection; never 'no'.

functions.name: flood_planning
functions.what: Endpoint: pooled connection, one retry on a fresh one if the answer could not be checked.
functions.input: latitude, longitude and optional lot outline
functions.output: the same flood planning answer fields as before
functions.if_none: no DATABASE_URL falls back to the old single connection
functions.edge_cases: dead pooled connection discarded and retried
functions.failure_mode: both attempts failing returns value None with could not be checked

break_it.scenario: Lot point 6 m outside a partial council flood line
break_it.what_happens: With the lot it is yes; point only it says near the map
break_it.how: lot_wkt passed by all callers; _nearest_yes_m on partial path

break_it.scenario: Caller sends a neighbouring or stale lot outline
break_it.what_happens: Outline ignored and only the point rule is applied

break_it.scenario: Lot boundary in an unexpected coordinate system
break_it.what_happens: Helper returns null and the point rule is used

verified: Live DB on the fixture lot: point not known (5.9 m), lot yes
